done.why: Every remaining way on was blocked: unfinished passages, a locked grating, a nailed door, a closed canyon view. I'd found both treasures I could reach.

about: A cut-down Zork I. You collect treasures and put them in the living room trophy case. The underground is mostly unfinished, with signs saying 'Back soon'.

moments.note: The troll died in one sword blow, with no fight.
Pinned note on the unfinished east passage: 'Back soon. -- The Management.'
'You can't get up there with what you're carrying' with no hint that item count was the limit.
The grating is locked and I found no key.

wished: A way into the rest of the underground
The nailed west door to open

lines.line: The passage to the east has not been finished. A note is pinned to the rock: "Back soon. -- The Management."
lines.why: Funny way to say the map ends here.

lines.line: The chasm drops away from your feet into a dark that your lamp does not so much light as annoy.

fun.why: The early treasure run was satisfying but ended quickly.

engagement.why: A clear goal, but the content ran out.

difficulty.why: The troll fell at once and the puzzles were few.

interestingness.why: Familiar Zork with new twists: the troll, the gallery and studio rearranged, and the unfinished-area notes.
